## In plain English

On a tip with several running stories and several intent-constraint mints, `verify:intent-constraint` refuses unless someone pins `--plan-id` or `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE`. Local sessions can pin. CI merge-gate already has `GITHUB_PR_NUMBER` (docs-impact uses it) but never turns the PR body `deft-story: N` mark into that pin. Healthy product PRs stay MERGE-BLOCKED after Greptile CLEAN and TypeScript green even when the right mint already sits on `origin/<deliveryBranch>`. Prefer-A adds a first-class CI adopter: sole unambiguous `deft-story: N` selects the matching running brief plan id (`github.issue.<REST>`) for the merge-gate evaluate path, fails closed on missing or multi marks, shares the same association order with observable-scope (or documents the sibling keep-out), and tells operators the PR must carry the mark on multi-active tips.

## Lean

Bind Approach A.

### Approach A (Prefer)

1. Add a durable PR-story plan-id adopter used by merge-gate `verify:intent-constraint`: when `GITHUB_PR_NUMBER` / `--pr` is present, REST-fetch the PR body (reuse docs-impact `fetchPrBodyRest` pattern), parse `deft-story` marks via existing `parseAllDeftStoryMarks` / `parseDeftStoryMark`.
2. Authoritative association order: sole `deft-story: N` -> running active brief whose origin / `x-directive/plan-id.origin` is `#N` (or `owner/repo#N`) -> that brief `plan.id` (`github.issue.<REST>`) as the selected planId. Explicit `--plan-id` and `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` still win over PR adoption.
3. Fail closed when association is missing, multi-`deft-story`, no matching running brief, or selected planId has no merge-base mint; remediation text must name the required sole `deft-story: N` PR mark (and pin verbs for local).
4. Wire the adopter into the evaluate / `check:merge` path so CI does not need a one-off workflow env; keep Taskfile/CI free of hand-parsed shell plan-ids.
5. Document whether `verify:observable-scope` (same multi-running refuse class) shares the adopter in this ship; Prefer-A default is share the association helper, call from both selectors.
6. Tests: sole deft-story pin succeeds; multi deft-story refuses; missing association with multi-running refuses; mint present for adopted planId authorizes covered facts; explicit `--plan-id` still overrides.
7. Docs (commands.md and/or scm/github.md + intent-constraint.md) state the association contract for multi-active tips; CHANGELOG Unreleased.

### Approach B

Workflow-only shell before `task check:merge`: parse PR body in CI YAML, export `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` or pass `--plan-id`. Reject as Prefer-A primary: duplicates selector outside evaluate, fragile vs REST body encoding, and docs-impact already shows in-engine PR adoption.

### Approach C

Soften multi-mint / multi-running refuse so any covering mint authorizes new facts without a pin. Reject: issue non-goal; old mints must not authorize new work.

## Reject

- Softening intent-constraint so multi-mint tips pass without a pin.
- Replacing leftover-complete / lifecycle hygiene as the fix for multi-active tips.
- Agent-shell mint bypass.
- One-off workflow env / YAML plan-id parse as the durable SoT.
- Guessing among mints when `deft-story` is missing or ambiguous.

## file_scope (lean)

- packages/core/src/intent-constraint/evaluate.ts
- packages/core/src/intent-constraint/ (PR-story plan-id adopter helper; may live beside pr-closing-keywords parsers)
- packages/core/src/observable-scope/evaluate.ts (shared adopter call, or documented keep-out if Round-1 rejects share-this-ship)
- packages/core/src/docs/docs-impact.ts (reuse fetchPrBodyRest only; no docs-impact behavior change)
- packages/core/src/pr-closing-keywords/main.ts (reuse parse helpers only)
- packages/cli or tasks/verify.yml / Taskfile wiring if --pr must reach evaluate
- content/docs/intent-constraint.md
- content/commands.md and/or content/scm/github.md
- CHANGELOG.md
- matching *.test.ts

## Keep-outs

- Softening the multi-mint refuse itself
- Leftover-complete / thinning actives as substitute for CI pin
- #5010 mint mid-build product
- #4813 wrong-diff consumers redesign
- Agent-shell attended mint bypass

Round 1 fresh critique of [Prefer-A](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/5782#issuecomment-6277513057) and [Stop 1](https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/5782#issuecomment-6277519148). Ceiling: 6277546666. Verification: read-only `git show 4e250c7db130fb2d6daf55fea79810e64439fd79:`; no fixtures executed, no sibling critiques read.

## Assessment and existing mechanisms

Prefer A's in-engine placement is sound. At the pinned SHA, both evaluators already select explicit plan ids, read DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE, scan running briefs, and refuse ambiguous mint ownership. Intent-constraint additionally refuses an invalid environment pin; observable-scope currently falls through. Both select merge-base records and refuse multiple records for a selected plan id. Keep those authority checks.

`parseAllDeftStoryMarks` already supplies distinct positive issue numbers; `parseDeftStoryMark` returns only the first. `fetchPrBodyRest` already provides REST transport, not an ownership proof. CI's primary and failover check:merge steps export GITHUB_PR_NUMBER; Taskfile invokes both gates and tasks/verify.yml forwards CLI arguments into the engine. Docs-impact receives its PR number through an explicit task argument: the transport helper itself does not adopt the environment variable.

Evidence: pinned [intent evaluator](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/4e250c7db130fb2d6daf55fea79810e64439fd79/packages/core/src/intent-constraint/evaluate.ts), [observable evaluator](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/4e250c7db130fb2d6daf55fea79810e64439fd79/packages/core/src/observable-scope/evaluate.ts), [mark parsers/admission](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/4e250c7db130fb2d6daf55fea79810e64439fd79/packages/core/src/pr-closing-keywords/main.ts), [REST helper](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/4e250c7db130fb2d6daf55fea79810e64439fd79/packages/core/src/docs/docs-impact.ts), [CI](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/4e250c7db130fb2d6daf55fea79810e64439fd79/.github/workflows/ci.yml), [Taskfile](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/4e250c7db130fb2d6daf55fea79810e64439fd79/Taskfile.yml), [task wiring](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/4e250c7db130fb2d6daf55fea79810e64439fd79/tasks/verify.yml).

## C1 — blocks-the-design: one mark does not guarantee one associated brief

Evidence: Prefer-A step 2 specifies a sole mark but does not require exactly one matching running brief or resolve conflicting origin fields. Existing selectors deliberately avoid choosing the only already-minted sibling.

Failure mode: two running briefs can claim the same issue with different plan ids. Selecting the first origin match, or preferring the match with a mint, makes filesystem order or old mint availability determine authorization. A bare #N also needs a repository context; another repository's #N must not match.

Consequence: bind only after specifying exactly one matching running brief with a nonempty plan.id, repository-qualified issue matching, and refusal on conflicting supported identity fields or multiple matches. Read that brief's actual id; do not synthesize github.issue.N from the issue number. Add duplicate-origin/different-plan, foreign-repository, and conflict cases.

Do not substitute the broad existing `collectGithubRefs` for primary-story identity without narrowing it: [refs.ts](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/4e250c7db130fb2d6daf55fea79810e64439fd79/packages/core/src/orphan-active/refs.ts) also collects parent_issue and decomposition_origin. An umbrella reference is not necessarily the current story.

## C2 — blocks-the-design: preserve invalid-pin refusal across adoption

Evidence: intent's resolveCurrentPlanId returns invalid-pin for an unreadable or non-running DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE. Observable's sibling silently falls through. Prefer-A says explicit inputs win, but does not specify what happens when that higher-priority input is invalid.

Failure mode: sharing the weaker resolver, or interpreting an invalid pin as no pin, permits PR adoption or a sole running sibling to select another story's existing mint. This reverses an existing fail-closed condition.

Consequence: specify a typed resolution outcome that distinguishes absent input from invalid/conflicting input. Intent's invalid pin remains terminal; a failed requested PR lookup or ambiguous association must likewise never fall through to a unique running story or available mint. Cover stale environment pins, REST failure, and selected-story-without-mint while another story has a covering mint. Explicit valid --plan-id can retain its documented precedence.

## C3 — sharpens-framing: define adoption at the mint-selection point

Evidence: intent returns success before selecting any mint when there are no new facts. Observable exits for absent policy or out-of-surface paths before selecting a mint. Prefer-A steps 1 and 3 could instead be read as requiring a mark whenever CI supplies a PR number.

Failure mode: unconditional network lookup/missing-mark refusal turns documentation-only or otherwise non-demanding PRs into failures unrelated to these gates.

Consequence: state that existing demand/skip behavior remains; invoke adoption when the evaluator needs story ownership, before the existing implicit unique-running fallback. In that demanded PR context, missing/ambiguous association refuses even if a stale singleton mint exists. Test no-demand PRs without marks and demanded PRs with failed lookup. Keep local no-PR behavior explicit.

## C4 — sharpens-framing: sharing is useful, but does not imply identical evaluators

Evidence: Taskfile runs both gates; observable has the same ambiguous selection failure but different policy/demand behavior and different invalid-pin handling.

Failure mode: an intent-only change still blocks a PR needing observable authorization on a multi-active tip. Conversely, sharing the entire evaluator or moving network lookup ahead of demand changes unrelated observable behavior.

Consequence: prefer sharing the narrow association resolver and calling it from both selection sites this ship. Preserve each gate's merge-base oracle and demand checks. A documented observable keep-out is honest only if the accepted scope explicitly leaves that CI failure unresolved; documentation alone cannot count as fixing it.

## C5 — sharpens-framing: make the trust and mismatch contract explicit

Evidence: CI supplies the PR locator, but the fetched body is editable association data; the existing mark parser matches standalone lines, including lines inside fenced examples. Existing full-story admission has productPullRequest checks, but returns early when no nonterminal brief changed.

Failure mode: a stale or deliberately wrong deft-story mark can point at a different running story with an old covering mint. Tracking text must not silently override the selected mark, and shell interpolation of body text would introduce an unnecessary execution surface.

Consequence: declare the CI repository/event PR locator as the input trust boundary; validate numeric PR input and use argument-array REST calls. Treat marks only as association, never mint creation or permission to pool records. Define Tracking mismatch behavior (diagnose/refuse or explicitly non-authoritative), mark-in-example behavior, and any reuse of existing productPullRequest binding checks. Test wrong-story association and Tracking disagreement. If correspondence beyond the declared mark is intentionally trusted to the PR author, state that limitation rather than claiming the adopter proves authorship of the work.

## Road not taken

Workflow-only selection has the strongest case as a small patch using already trusted event metadata. I still prefer the engine because direct CLI use and both evaluator callers need the same selection contract. That verdict would flip only if scope were explicitly limited to this one workflow and the shared semantics were already implemented elsewhere. Accept-any-covering-mint remains unsuitable: it removes story ownership rather than resolving it.

## Re-verify (tip anchors)

- `packages/core/src/intent-constraint/evaluate.ts`: `resolveCurrentPlanId` admits explicit `--plan-id`, then `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` running brief, then sole running `plan.id`; otherwise `kind: none`. Evaluate config-fails when `planId` unresolved and `parsedRecords.length > 1 || running.length > 1` (`old mints must not authorize new work`).
- `packages/core/src/observable-scope/evaluate.ts`: sibling `resolveCurrentPlanId` + the same multi-running / multi-mint refuse string. No PR / `GITHUB_PR_NUMBER` / `deft-story` path in either evaluator.
- `packages/cli/src/verify-intent-constraint.ts` / `verify-observable-scope.ts`: `--plan-id` only; no `--pr`; no env PR adoption.
- `packages/core/src/pr-closing-keywords/main.ts`: `parseDeftStoryMark` / `parseAllDeftStoryMarks` already exist (line-anchored `deft-story: N`).
- `packages/core/src/docs/docs-impact.ts`: `fetchPrBodyRest` already REST-fetches PR bodies; CI docs-impact step passes `--pr` from `GITHUB_PR_NUMBER`.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: `task check:merge` already exports `GITHUB_PR_NUMBER` from `github.event.pull_request.number` (forge-trusted) plus `GH_TOKEN`.
- `Taskfile.yml` `check:framework-source` / `check:merge`: both `verify:observable-scope` and `verify:intent-constraint` sit on the merge chokepoint.
- Ownership already mechanized: `briefOwnsIssue` / `planIdBindingOrigin` in `packages/core/src/intake/residual-identity.ts` (binding `origin` `owner/repo#N` + provenance Origin); `readStoredPlanIdBinding` parses `x-directive/plan-id`.
- Parallel env pattern: `verify-closing-keywords.ts` `resolveClosingKeywordsSource` already reads `GITHUB_PR_NUMBER ?? PR_NUMBER`.

## Inventory before new mechanism

Tip already refuses multi-running without pin; PR bodies already carry `deft-story`; docs-impact already fetches PR bodies in CI; check:merge already exports the PR number; closing-keywords already treats that env as PR identity. Prefer-A correctly puts adoption **in-engine** (Approach A) and rejects workflow-only YAML parse (Approach B) and multi-mint soften (Approach C). The missing piece is a shared selector that turns sole `deft-story: N` into the running brief `plan.id` before the existing refuse, reusing parsers + `fetchPrBodyRest` + ownership predicates — not a new association dialect.

## Findings

### F1 — blocks-the-design: observable-scope keep-out leaves merge-gate pain unrelieved

- **class:** blocks-the-design
- **evidence:** Stop 1 P1/P3 + tip `Taskfile.yml`: `check:merge` runs `verify:observable-scope` **and** `verify:intent-constraint`. Both evaluators share the multi-running refuse. Prefer-A limb 5 / file_scope allows Round-1 to take a documented keep-out on sharing the adopter this ship.
- **failure mode:** Intent-constraint adopts and goes green; observable-scope still config-fails on the same multi-active tip. Evidence class PR #5761 / mint #5777 stays MERGE-BLOCKED after Greptile CLEAN + TypeScript green.
- **disposition consequence:** Prefer-A cannot bind with share-or-keep-out as co-equal. Bind **share-this-ship**: one association helper, called from both selectors (or an equivalent same-ship pin for both). Honest keep-out only if a different same-ship pin unblocks observable-scope on check:merge; otherwise keep-out fails to relieve P1/P3.

## Summary

`verify:intent-constraint` (and the same selector pattern in related scope gates) refuses when tip has multiple running stories or multiple merge-base mint records unless `--plan-id` or `DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE` pins the current story. Local operators can pin. **CI merge-gate does not.** On a healthy multi-active tip, product PRs that introduce new intent hard facts stay MERGE-BLOCKED even when Greptile and TypeScript are green and the mint already exists on `origin/<deliveryBranch>`.

Evidence: PR #5761 (Tracking #5742). Intent remint for numeric-const 512/200/40 landed on master via #5777. Product tip was cleaned to product-only. Greptile CLEAN. TypeScript green. Merge gate still fails with:

> multiple running stories or merge-base mint records; pass --plan-id or pin DEFT_ACTIVE_SCOPE …

This issue asks for a **first-class gate feature**: merge-gate / `check:merge` adopts the current plan id from durable PR story association so CI can select the mint the same way a pinned local session does.

## Current shape

- Selector lives in `packages/core/src/intent-constraint/evaluate.ts` (`resolveCurrentPlanId` / multi-running refuse).
- Same class of refuse exists for observable-scope selection.
- PR bodies already carry `deft-story: N` (see orphan-active / running-briefs: durable mark equivalent).
- Docs-impact CI already passes `GITHUB_PR_NUMBER` into a gate; intent-constraint merge-gate path does not adopt plan id from the PR.

## What to build

1. **Adopt plan id in CI merge-gate** for `verify:intent-constraint` (and document whether observable-scope / sibling selectors share the adopter).
2. **Authoritative association order** (Prefer-A to lock): e.g. sole `deft-story: N` → running brief for that issue → `github.issue.<id>` planId; refuse on ambiguous multi-`deft-story` / mismatch with Tracking.
3. **Fail closed** when association is missing or ambiguous (do not guess among mints).
4. **Tests** for: sole deft-story pin succeeds; multi deft-story refuses; missing association with multi-running refuses; mint present for adopted planId authorizes covered facts.
5. **Docs** for operators: PR body must carry `deft-story: N` (or the locked association) when tip is multi-active.

## Acceptance

- [ ] On a tip with multiple running actives and multiple intent mints, a PR whose body has a sole unambiguous `deft-story: N` (or locked equivalent) gets `--plan-id` / equivalent selection in merge-gate CI and can go green when the merge-base mint covers the new facts.
- [ ] Ambiguous or missing association still fails closed with a remediation that names the required PR mark.
- [ ] Unit/integration coverage for the adopter + evaluate path.
- [ ] CHANGELOG Unreleased notes the CI/merge-gate plan-id adoption.
- [ ] Docs (commands or scm/github) state the association contract.

## Non-goals

- Softening intent-constraint so multi-mint tips pass without a pin.
- Replacing leftover-complete / lifecycle hygiene (thinning actives remains separate work).
- Agent-shell mint bypass.
- One-off workflow env for a single PR.

## Refs

- Blocks merge of #5761 (Tracking #5742) after mint #5777 on master
- Extends #4541 intent-constraint gate family
- Related closed design: #5010 (mint mid-build), #4813 (wrong diff consumers)
- Selector: `packages/core/src/intent-constraint/evaluate.ts`
- PR mark: `deft-story: N` / running-briefs durable mark

## Pre-filing

Searched open/closed for intent-constraint + plan-id / ACTIVE_SCOPE / merge-gate plan adoption. No open issue owns CI merge-gate plan-id adoption from PR story association. Closest shipped roots: #4541, #5010, #4813.
